when the fine-tuning dataset is sufficient, deep learning and foundation models such as CPA and scGPT are preferable.

when the dataset includes perturbation dosage information, scVIDR is the best method.
For the accurate prediction of the top most differentially expressed genes, scPRAM is the optimal choice.

limitations.statement: The proposed cellular context embedding strategy is currently applicable only to cell-line-derived contexts, not patient-derived contexts.
Robustness evaluation focuses on technical artifacts (noise, sparsity) rather than biological variability.
The cellular context embedding strategy shows only limited improvements (mainly in PCC-delta and Common-DEGs) and does not consistently surpass baseline methods across all metrics.
In certain test scenarios, the available datasets are currently insufficient, which may lead to bias.
Current work does not address poor performance on population-distribution metrics.
